title: System Init — Brand migration + Sprint closures + COO brief
summary: ProHelp brand confirmed, all docs/AppDB migrated from Servio. sprint-001 closed, sprint-008 gated. COO v1 brief written ahead of May 1 start.
details: BRAND: ProHelp/prohelp.work confirmed by founder. All docs (privacy-policy-v0.1.md, terms-of-service-v0.1.md, coo-brief-v1.md) and AppDB (38 rows) fully migrated — 0 Servio residuals. SPRINTS: sprint-001 (CFO ramp model) → COMPLETED. sprint-008 (Sicily/Barcelona scale) → PLANNED/GATED until sprint-003 hits 50 providers in Malta. COO BRIEF: docs/coo-brief-v1.md written (7KB) — covers ProHelp brand, 5 service categories + priority, tech stack (Next.js 14 + PostgreSQL + NextAuth v5 + Vercel free), financial model (€35 avg, 15% commission, €19 Pro, M1=20 orders+5 Pro), first-100 providers 3-phase plan (€700-800, CAC €10). REPORTING: dashboard channel active (reports.prohelp.work). Future reports will use this channel only. Founder chat reserved for critical decisions, security, sprint completion milestones only.
